problem: Model-authored raw dependency edges, verifier judgments, frozen claims, typed graph edges and executable fixture oracles can disagree because no single deterministic component owns live current-turn dependency compilation.

selected_responsibilities: Semantic Writer declares Goals and typed input sources.
Typed Goal Graph compiler owns current-turn dependency edges.
Runtime, workflow and executable semantic fixtures project from the sealed graph.
preserved_hard_invariants: No keyword routing or nearest-match capability authority is added.
cutover_strategy: Remove raw depends_on from new provider input, freeze verified input_bindings, deterministically compile and seal edges, and migrate every executable new-turn fixture and runtime consumer in the same candidate. Historical contracts use an explicit read-only compatibility branch that cannot accept new writes or override a typed verdict.
acceptance_claims: Provider schema requires input_bindings and contains no depends_on field.
Every current_goal_output binding creates exactly one traceable edge.
Shared subjects and historical visible references create no current-turn edge.
Identity, type, cardinality, scope and proof mismatches fail closed.
Executable fixture and smoke oracles compare the compiled graph.
Product Quick converges before any push or release.
